responsibility: Bridges GCC’s DWARF DIE representation to the CTF/BTF subsystem by traversing compiler-generated DIEs and synthesizing CTF container records from them. This file maps DWARF types, functions, variables, members, arrays, enums, qualifiers, and special cases such as implicit void or unknown/unrepresentable types into CTF IDs, provides DIE-based file/line/column accessors used for CTF/BTF source-location needs, and coordinates CTF/BTF initialization, optional BTF postprocessing, and final handoff to the CTF or BTF emitters.
same_name_distinction: Implements the DWARF-to-CTF/BTF bridge declared in dwarf2ctf.h by traversing GCC DWARF DIEs, synthesizing CTF records, creating placeholder DIEs such as void/unknown, and driving init/final output. Unlike the header, it contains the translation logic rather than just the interface used from dwarf2out.c and ctfc.c.
